rule: **Rust**: no module prefix: `Type#method` (impl and trait methods), free functions bare; module paths keep `::` (`std::env::var`); `Type::assoc` → `Type#assoc`. | `self.m()` / `this.m()` / a bare call to a member of the enclosing type → `Type#m`. | **Rust constructors type their binding**: `let x = T { .. }` and `let x = T::new(..)` / `T::default()` / `T::with_capacity(..)` give `x` type T
notes: Layout: src/ (the scan root) holds a Cargo package, Cargo.toml plus src/*.rs, so module paths are crate-relative. Self::/Counter:: associated calls → Counter#assoc. `Counter { count }` is data construction (no edge); `self.count += 1` is field access. `let mut c = Counter::new()` types c as Counter → Counter#bump high. main is a bare free function. call_type: SPEC lists direct|method without defining them; this corpus uses method for every callee of the form Type#m / recv.m / .m (including path calls Type::assoc()) and direct for free functions, module-path functions and named nested functions.
